deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Settings" > "Policies".
In the policies page, click on "Return Policy".
Scroll down to the "Return Reason" section and click on the "Add return reason" button.
Enter a name for the return reason and select the type (e.g. 'Reason', 'Cause').
Click "Save" to save the new return reason.
To embed the returns reason capture form, navigate to your Shopify theme's liquid files.
Open the `returns.liquid` file and add the following code snippet: `<form id='return-reason-form'>...</form>`
In the same file, add a JavaScript file (e.g., `script.js`) that will handle the form submission.
In the `script.js` file, use Shopify's API to create an AJAX request to submit the return reason data.

Use the following code snippet as a reference: `$.ajax({ url: '/api/2022-04/orders/{order_id}/return_reasons.json', method: 'POST', data: { order_id: '{order_id}', return_reason: $('#return-reason-form').serialize() }, success: function(data) { console.log('Return reason submitted successfully'); } });`
Replace `{order_id}` with the actual order ID and `#return-reason-form` with the form's ID.
Save both files and preview your returns page to test the embedded return reason capture form.
